name: M5.CompletionBlock.union_divisibility
statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A U : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A U → (P ∣ M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U) ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U) = AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A))
context:
theorem M5.CompletionBlock.support_union : ∀ A U : Finset ℕ, Disjoint A U → M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U) = M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A + M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U := by
  change ∀ A U : Finset ℕ, Disjoint A U → M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U) = M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A + M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U
  intro A U h
  unfold M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport
  exact Finset.sum_union h
guidance: Use support_union, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero and map_add. In characteristic2, x+y=0 iff y=x. No nonzero or irreducibility premise; empty selected/extension sets allowed. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
